label: Bible Study
prompt: For with God nothing shall be _____.
verse: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
note: Gabriel's word to Mary — a good line to keep within reach.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be _____, neither let it be afraid.
verse: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
note: Jesus gives peace the way the world can't — as a bequest, the night before the cross.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Go ye therefore, and _____ all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
verse: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
note: Modern versions say 'make disciples,' but the KJV's Great Commission says 'teach all nations.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: And they that be _____ shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
verse: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
note: Daniel's closing promise: soul-winners get stellar treatment — literally, shining like stars.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But made himself of no _____, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
verse: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
note: He 'made himself of no reputation' — the KJV's rendering of the great self-emptying, the kenosis.
